text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - FN_CALL error burst detected. External function invocation rate spiked in us-west-2 and is causing elevated latencies and OOM churn on infer nodes. Pager 98765. Please ack.

maya (oncall): Ack. I'm investigating. Paging @sanjay @leah. Starting an emergency mitigation plan.

sanjay: looking at prometheus - fncall_qps doubled for tenants t-42 and t-7, agent-proxy CPU at 92%. KV cache hit unchanged. Looks like downstream agents are retrying.

leah: thanks - I'm prepping a proxy-level config flip. Proposal: short-term 'firebreak' - disable external action execution (soft-fail to text-only) + global fncall throttle for free tier. Keep paying tenants on dedicated as a canary.

maya (oncall): Plan:
1) throttle fncall QPS by 50% for free tier and burst limit 10/s per tenant
2) flip proxy feature flag to disable external exec (soft) in us-west-2
3) clamp structured_output to 512 tokens and fall back to plain text
4) notify top-5 impacted customers and update status page

leah: applying flag now (rolling 10%->70%).

```bash
# soft-disable external exec in us-west-2
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/admin/flags" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"proxy.allow_external_exec","value":false,"region":"us-west-2"}'
```

ops-bot: action: flag update queued. rollout: 0% -> 70% in progress. uuid=flag-op-82

tim: I'll handle customer comms. Drafting message to affected tenants and status page now. Will post link when published.

maya (oncall): enacted fncall throttle via staging policy. Command:

```
adminctl rate-limit set --scope free --endpoint fncall --qps 50% --tenant-burst 10
```

sanjay: after throttle and flag rollout p50 latency down from 420ms -> 130ms in us-west-2. Agent queue depth falling. Looks effective.

leah: enabling pass-through canary for dedicated tenants so enterprise workloads keep running (region-scoped). Will mark as exempt.

maya (oncall): Customer outreach posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/98765 - top 5 tenants contacted via support tickets.

tim: sent messages to impacted customers, added a note to the ticket for follow-up call windows.

ops-bot: rollout at 70% complete. No errors in rollout logs. Monitoring for anomalies.

sanjay: recommend we keep these mitigations for 30 minutes and re-evaluate metrics (fncall_qps, latency, error-rate). If stable, we can start phased re-enable with tighter quotas.

maya (oncall): Agreed. Handoff to night on-call @evan at 23:00 UTC. Evan — please own until we either fully re-enable or open a postmortem.

evan: Acknowledge. I'll monitor dashboards, escalate if error-rate exceeds 2% or latency p95 > 300ms. Contact chain on my calendar.

maya (oncall): Thanks team. Closing this Slack thread for operational handoff, keeping incident in 'monitoring' state. Will start postmortem draft after stabilization. :thumbsup: :eyes:
